"""Soak test with pathological service tokens and structures."""
import json
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import ref
import validate_out

MAIN = "/workspace/submission/main.py"
TOKENS = ["a", "A", " ", "  ", "\t", "\n", "\"", "\\", "{", "}", "[", "]", ",", ":",
          "0", "-1", "null", "true", "é", "e\u0301", "\U0001F600", "日本", "�x",
          "a" * 64, "\x7f", "\x1f", "π", "Ω", "ß", "ﬁ", "İ", "ı", "﻿",
          "﻿x", "x﻿", "\ud83d\ude00" if False else "😀"]


def run(payload):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN], input=payload,
                       capture_output=True, cwd="/workspace/tmp/dev")
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:2000]
    return [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]


def gen(rng):
    n = rng.randint(0, 6)
    services = rng.sample(TOKENS, n)
    rules = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 5)):
        op = rng.choice(["match", "startswith", "endswith", "contains"])
        path = [rng.choice(services) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 4))] if services else []
        e = {"op": op, "path": path}
        if rng.random() < 0.3:
            e = {"op": "not", "arg": e}
        elif rng.random() < 0.3:
            e = {"op": rng.choice(["and", "or"]), "args": [e, {"op": "false"}, {"op": "true"}]}
        rules.append({"action": rng.choice(["allow", "drop"]), "when": e})
    queries = [[rng.choice(services) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 8))] if services else []
               for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 5))]
    return {"services": services, "rules": rules, "queries": queries}


def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]); count = int(sys.argv[2])
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    bundles = [gen(rng) for _ in range(count)]
    payload = b"".join((json.dumps(b) + "\n").encode() for b in bundles)
    outs = run(payload)
    assert len(outs) == len(bundles)
    for b, o in zip(bundles, outs):
        want = ref.ref_compile(b)
        assert o == want, ("mismatch", json.dumps(b), json.dumps(o)[:300], json.dumps(want)[:300])
        if o.get("ok"):
            validate_out.validate(o, b, sample=15, rng=rng)
    print("validated %d weird-token bundles" % count)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
